name: synth_knee_below_plateau
description: A Kang-like rank curve: ambient at 1-3 UMIs (plateau lower 7), a dense debris band at 8-14 UMIs whose drop-off is the sharpest bend among the totals > lower, an ambient shoulder of 15-~150 UMIs, called cells at 1,000-16,000 UMIs and low-RNA cells at 200-1,000. The unbounded knee lands at 8, so every tested barcode (the ambient shoulder included) was called.
